tagline: Hawaii's gateway and the hub of an all-electric inter-island network — the place to do the Superferry right.
summary: Oʻahu holds roughly 70% of Hawaii's population and the overwhelming majority of its inbound air capacity. Honolulu Harbor, Ala Wai and Kewalo Basin form a dense urban waterfront, while the leeward (Ko Olina) and windward (Kāneʻohe) coasts carry heavy resort, commuter and visitor demand that the single congested H-1 corridor serves poorly. Oʻahu is simultaneously Navier's US-Pacific super-app proving ground — Honolulu is an active Uber market — and the natural hub of an inter-island network: Molokaʻi and Lānaʻi sit inside Pioneer II all-electric range across the Kaʻiwi and Kalohi channels, and Maui and Kauaʻi open on Quanta-LR. It is also the place to retell the Hawaii Superferry story correctly: a quiet, low-wake, zero-emission foiling vessel answers the wake, whale-strike and environmental objections that grounded the 2007–2009 Superferry.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the intra-Oʻahu layer (Ko Olina, Kāneʻohe, Hawaiʻi Kai) and the all-electric inter-island hops to Molokaʻi (~25 nm) and Lānaʻi (~65 nm, edge of range).
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) unlocks the inter-island line-hauls to Maui (~75 nm) and Kauaʻi (~72 nm) with no charging dependency — the 'Superferry done right' network.

competitive_landscape: Inter-island air (Hawaiian, Southwest, Mokulele) is the dominant substitute; tour-boat RIB and catamaran operators fragment the leisure layer. There is no scheduled inter-island ferry today, leaving a clear opening. Uber and local challenger Holoholo are the demand-platform partners.
seasonality: Year-round visitor demand; trade-wind swell freshens the windward and channel crossings in winter, and humpback season (Dec–Apr) imposes whale-avoidance speed discipline on inter-island legs — a comfort and safety story a foiling hull serves well.
regulatory_note: The Superferry precedent makes Hawaii environmental review (HEPA / EIS) the central gating factor for any inter-island service; a zero-emission, low-wake foiling profile is the direct answer. US Coast Guard Subchapter T inspection applies; Hawaiʻi DOT Harbors controls berth access.

precedents.why_it_matters: Shows the premium on-demand water network model an island archipelago with concentrated wealth and weak road links can support.
Foiling is culturally native to the Pacific sailing world, easing the 'is this proven?' objection.
